# Azure SQL Hub

> One front door for developers and AI agents to start building on Azure SQL. Three ways in: run the Azure SQL Database engine locally in a container, create a free database in the Microsoft Azure cloud, or install the agent skills and let an AI coding agent do the setup. The container is in Private Preview. The Azure SQL Database free offer works with any Azure subscription type.

Every page on this site is authored as markdown. Append `.md` to any page URL to
fetch that source, or read {{ '/llms-full.txt' | absolute_url }} for the whole
site as a single document.

## Pages
- [Azure SQL Hub]({{ '/index.md' | absolute_url }}): the home page. Quickstart command for the local container, the three starting paths (local, cloud, agent), step-by-step setup for each, and the agent skill install commands for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Cursor.

## Key facts
- Local: the Azure SQL Database container image is `sqldbpreview-dpgaeqhmgphzd4bk.azurecr.io/azure-sql/db-dev`, x64 (linux/amd64). On a host that is not x64, add `--platform linux/amd64`. The registry is private during the Private Preview; credentials come from signing up at https://aka.ms/sqldbcontainerpreview-signup.
- Cloud: the Azure SQL Database free offer gives 100,000 vCore seconds of serverless compute, 32 GB of data, and 32 GB of backup storage per database per month, for up to 10 databases per Azure subscription. It needs an Azure account and subscription, and is created from the Azure portal.
- Agent: 17 agent skills install with `npx skills add microsoft/azure-sql-database-container` in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code with GitHub Copilot. Claude Code and Codex can also install them as a native plugin with `/plugin marketplace add microsoft/azure-sql-database-container`.
- Connection: TCP port 1433, SQL login (sa) locally, Microsoft Entra in the cloud. Moving from the local container to Azure SQL Database in the cloud is a connection-string change, not a code change.

## Related sites
- [Azure SQL Database container]({{ site.container_site }}): the container documentation, including prerequisites, getting started, agent skills, and known limitations.
- [Container repository]({{ site.container_repo }}): source, skills, and issues.
- [Azure SQL Database free offer]({{ site.azure_free_offer }}): current limits, behavior at the monthly cap, and exclusions.

## Status
- The Azure SQL Database container is in Private Preview.
- This site is in active development. Sections for connect, build, and samples are not published yet.
